newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: UN World Youth forum to debate poverty, abuse.
newsitem.headline: UN World Youth forum to debate poverty, abuse.

text.p: U.N. Secretary-General Boutros Boutros-Ghali, in a message to a world youth forum in Vienna, called on governments to listen to the voices of the young and heed their concerns when formulating policies for the future.
The world youth forum opened in the Austrian capital on Monday, with some 300 delegates from 150 nations scheduled to address such issues as poverty, health, and drug abuse.

"The World Youth Forum provides an unprecedented opportunity for all of us in the United Nations system to listen to the voices of youth and consider anew how we can respond to their concerns," Boutros-Ghali said in a message read out at the opening session.

The U.N. General Assembly last December adopted a World Programme of Action for Youth to the year 2000, setting out a series of time-limited targets for action on youth issues at national, regional and global level.
The Vienna forum was to hold a series of workshops focusing on the problems of urban migration, unemployment, juvenile violence and sexual exploitation. The forum ends on Friday.
